name: claude-ask-modal
description: Shows Claude Code questions as a full-window modal with briefing screens, markdown, mermaid diagrams, clickable links, images, previews, a review step and a Dig deeper button; every recommendation is pre-checked by a reviewer model (codex or claude accounts) and can be checked again with any reviewer. Answers return over a local MCP server.

claudeAskModal.port.description: Fallback localhost port (user setting) for Claude sessions with no per-project registration. Set it in workspace settings to pin this workspace's port instead of the one derived from its folder path.

claudeAskModal.reviewers.description: Reviewer accounts that check Claude's recommendations. The first entry with preCheck reviews every decision before it is shown. A claude entry without home is the calling Claude session (run as its own subagent).

name.description: Short account name shown in the modal.

home.description: CODEX_HOME (codex) or CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR (claude) of this account; omitted = the default login.

preCheck.description: Model and effort for the automatic pre-check.

commands.title: Claude Ask Modal: Show test question
Claude Ask Modal: Log in reviewer account
